strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
I failed before... Heh heh, but not this time...!
Come, Mia Alice...! Though that bunch from before might be fun too...
Boss Gil, whatcha waitin' for?
It's none of your concern. Let's go.
(What's with this guy? ...Can't figure out Boss Lady Diondra either.
Why's she backin' a jerk like him?)
Huh... What, enemies!?
Damn, they've already spread out this far!
Those are... Gyandlar machines, I believe. We're late, Captain.
What? Mechanical Beasts?
They seem a little different.
Just what... are these things?
They do kind of look like Mechanical Beasts or Battle Beasts.
Who cares what they are! Let's just blast 'em!
Seconded~! Shall we just get it over with?
Ah! It's that bunch from before! Ya got guts! I'll whup ya! Get 'em!
What's going on here!? Captain!
They're not taking this seriously, but... no choice. Intercept them!
It seems several have already descended to Earth.
We can't let any more get through.
All hands, launch as soon as you're ready!
Again and again, you never learn...!
That's my line, ya moron!
Anyone who gets in the way of us Gyandlar gets no mercy!
Ugh, he's so annoying! Brother, take him down!
The Gyandlar and one more... Are there two organizations?
We have far too little information...!
It's not Mia Alice? How dull!
But... you'll at least make a decent warm-up... Heh heh.
Anyway, that robot seems to be aiming for Earth too. Let's sortie.
All right! All hands, sortie!
Hyo!? What's this, what's this!? A human force!?
Oh, for crying out loud!
No doubt about it... That's a Gaizok battleship.
It seems they managed to drive it off Earth.
Hm!? ...I see, the Gaizok... Heh heh... Luck seems to be on my side.
But the timing is bad...!
To think we have to face three armies at once!
We can't let them slip down to Earth in the confusion!
Right, don't let your guard down!
This is rough, man!
We've got no choice!
Hm!? But from the look of it, it's taken heavy damage.
On the ground?
Looks like it.
Natural, considering what the Gandor unit is capable of.
So they got kicked out, huh?
Mind your own business!
A reading!? Something else coming up from Earth!?
That giant robot with the crescent moon!?
This ID signal... No doubt about it.
Who are these robots!?
New enemies... No, the space forces! That's a Federation battleship!
Then that means it's Londo Bell!
Is this Captain Bright Noa!? This is the Jin family, Zambot 3!
Please give us support!
I've heard about you from Commander Hazuki of the Gandor unit.
We'll keep sweeping up the Gaizok machines.
Oh, you're so very persistent! You blasted brats!
Of course we are!
Like we'd let a dangerous creep like you run loose!
You fight dirty! Trying to shoot down a defenseless HLV!
Defenseless my foot! Some weird robot came jumping out of it!
The Cyber Beast Force! ...But now they're missing...
What happened to the HLV and Dancougar after that!?
We knocked the Bandock off balance with a good hit, but... what happened?
I don't know.
We got the HLV's distress signal, so they may have met up by now...
but there's no response at all from the Cyber Beast Force.
Hey! Zambot team!
Koji! You're safe!?
Yeah! We already met up! Sorry for making you lure off the Gaizok.
Don't mention it. By the way, what happened to the Cyber Beast Force!?
They're not with you!?
...Then they're still missing.
What the heck, everybody's scattered all over the place!
Geez! Meanwhile we keep running into extras like the Nadesico!
Are you guys okay!?
Tetsuya! You're safe!
I owe you one. We managed to meet up.
I'll have to make the Gaizok pay me back for last time...!
Don't mention it. By the way, what happened to the Cyber Beast Force!?
Huh, weren't they with you!?
...Then they're still missing.
What the heck, everybody's scattered all over the place!
We did run into the Nadesico, though. Things never go that smoothly.
Let's count ourselves lucky these two teams made it back. For now...!
Bah, you little whelps! What are you jabbering about!?
Here they come!
Tch, Kappei! Think later! If we dawdle, we're done for!
Okaaay! You clay doll creep! Get ready!
All right, destroy them one by one! Aim to finish them off here!
Oh, what cheeky little creatures you are!
Getting cocky just because there are a few more of you!
(Easy to say, but... the damage I took on Earth is just too great.)
This planet's space forces... are good...! But... hm!
An energy reading!? Coming at us at incredible speed...!
What!? Captain, friend or foe!?
Identification code... unknown. A new enemy model...?
Or an entirely new enemy...!
It's not out of the question, with so many mysterious invaders attacking.
How can you be so calm, Captain Quattro!? Isn't this bad news!?
Earth... So this is... my...
Mia! No time to get sentimental!
He's here!
So you've come!
Let's combine, c'mon!
...Let's do it...! Crooosss Fight!
Th-they combined!?
Just like Zambot.
Hey! Isn't that way too cool!? Seriously!
...Gil Berg!
Roll Kran! And... Mia Alice!
Wh-what!? They seem to be arguing about something...
Are they enemies? Or allies!?
Huh? What's that robot with spikes sticking out everywhere!?
There seems to be some history there. I hope this doesn't get messy...
What's going on!? Can you make it out, Jun?
There's too much static...
Gil! Stop dragging the people of Earth into this!
If you hold a grudge against me... then come after me alone!
That... That alone won't satisfy me...!
I must tear your homeland to shreds... and kill you in despair...!
Ugh, how does someone end up with a personality like that?
Did cyborg surgery fry part of his brain!? Roll, let him have it!
Are they at odds? Captain, are they responding to our hails?
I'm trying. Who are you people!?
Tch, what a pain! What now? If it comes to it, we take 'em all...
Hey, Pai! Don't say "what a pain"!
The people of Earth are Mia's friends! We can't let them get the wrong idea.
Here I come... Mia Alice!
Dangaioh won't lose...! Come on, Gil Berg!
...Do we... really have to fight?
Eek, it's starting! Everyone from Earth! Please don't shoot us!
What's going on!? Are they on our side!?
Mysterious allies... There's precedent for that, but...
What should we do!? Captain!
Don't engage unless attacked! I hate always reacting, but...
right now, keeping the invaders from reaching Earth comes first!
Easy for you to say, geez!
But as long as we're around, we won't let 'em slip away
like we did with the Bandock!
But... that robot does have me curious.
I'll dispose of you all at once!
What!? Again! Again, my Bloody is...!? Nuuuuurgh!
All right! It's working! Keep it up... Hm!?
I can't just slink away like this...!
Mia Alice! ...Follow me if you dare! I'll be waiting...!
Don't tell me... he's descending to the planet like that!?
The guy's got guts!
This is no time to be praising him!
Why... go that far...?
What!? He's trying to descend to Earth with that damage!?
Just burn up already!
No... it's not falling...!
What!?
...He still has power to spare...!
You're full of praise, but at this rate he'll hit the descent route!
Right! This is no time to be impressed! We gotta go after him!
That's right! In that case, Boss Borot will...!
Don't even think about it, Boss.
This is no time to be impressed! Let's catch him!
...No, it's impossible.
Tetsuya!?
Damn, he's descending!?
Dammit! Roll, we're going after him!
We have to... stop Gil...!
We'll split up and pursue! Dangaioh, Separaaate!
What!? Hey, if we separate now...!
They separated!?
In the end, they did help us, but...
Yet another new faction... There's no way we can contain them all.
Captain, aren't you sending a pursuit team?
Sadly... the only unit that can enter the atmosphere on its own now
is Grendizer. We can't spare it.
There's also... the Zeta Gundam. Either way, we're short on forces...
Hmph! Zambot can do that much too! Let's just...!
Kappei! We just came up from Earth chasing the Gaizok!
Seriously, man.
Defeating any remaining enemies... is all we can do.
Kiiih! Curse you! What a thoroughly infuriating bunch!
To deal this much damage to my Bandock!
Don't mess with us, you jerk!
We're gonna avenge our ancestors, every last bit!
Your ancestors!? Ho! Never heard of 'em!
I've destroyed a great many planets, you see.
You! After taking so many lives, you don't feel any guilt at all...!
What gives you the right!?
Hohohoho! Why did they have to be destroyed...?
Have you never thought about that?
...The reason... they were destroyed...?
Hoho, if you can't understand that, the only path left to you is ruin.
Either way, I'll kill every last one of you! Hohohohoho!
Screw you! Before that, I'll crush you all myself!
Try it if you think you can...! Don't think it'll be that easy...!
You creep, I'll shut that mouth of yours for good!
Time to finish this!
Hoho, I can't keep playing with you. My forces were half-baked anyway!
Next time we meet will be your end, so look forward to it!
Ah!
(Besides, I took far too much punishment on the ground...
Utterly outrageous... and dangerous creatures.)
He's running!? Captain, can we pursue!?
...No. To think he still had this much strength left...
Captain, he's wounded! If we pursue now...!
...No, we can't leave the Earth Sphere right now...
Move on to mopping up the remaining enemies.
Defensive fighting has its limits... We must find a countermeasure fast.
Looks like we drove them all off. But...
We couldn't stop the enemy's descent...
That's the second time now, after the Gaizok, Captain.
Well, we did kick the Gaizok off Earth, though.
Didn't they just leave on their own, chasing the HLV...?
Now, now, Keiko, let him have this one.
But that mysterious robot...
Didn't they say Dangai-something?
Is that robot from another world too? Umon, do you know anything?
...I don't know.
All I know are Grendizer from Planet Fleed, Vega's saucer beasts,
and Earth's robots, really.
They went after him, but I wonder how things are down on the ground?
I can't face Commander Hazuki... Another mysterious robot.
But hey, weren't they fighting against that Bunker army?
True, though we could barely get a transmission through...
But... thinking about it, quite a few have gotten into Earth, huh...
And down on the ground, that creep Dr. Hell's on a rampage again...
Weren't the Dinosaur Empire's remnants on the move too?
It's total chaos down there.
It's no different up here.
Dr. Hell on the move, the Dinosaur Empire's robots revived...
and now an alien invasion. Isn't the surface in trouble?
Koji... I wonder if he's all right.
Getter Robo's there too, so I doubt they'll go down easily, but...
Shouldn't you be worrying about us too, Jun?
I'm worried about the surface too... but we can only trust them.
I've heard of a new power leading Dr. Hell and the Dinosaur Empire.
But...
Our situation is no different.
Since we know nothing of who the enemy is, it's harder for us to plan.
It'd sure help if they'd cooperate with us like that champion of justice did.
And people call that... optimism, don't they?
Mmm, not bad, Maria.
Ahem. ...It seems it's over for now.
Once again, I'd like to ask for your help, Jin family: Kappei Jin,
Uchuta Kamie, Keiko Kamikita.
Leave it to us!
Didn't you say the same thing on the ground?
All we did was chase the Gaizok battleship and end up in space.
Aw, c'mon, forget the details.
To chase the Gaizok, we need to be with someone who has real firepower.
We'll lend you a hand.
Captain Bright Noa, we'll help too.
I'm sorry... All I can do is rely on the strength of children like you.
Beating yourself up won't help, Captain.
Man, woman, adult, child... Right now, everyone must do what they can.
That's right. It's not like we have much leeway.
Not exactly something to say so cheerfully, though.
Indeed. I'm worried about the Cyber Beast Force too, but...
in any case, I'll contact Commander Hazuki.
All right, Londo Bell heads to the next point. All units, return to base.
